items.name: Trevor Belmont
items.title: Le dernier pas avant l'impact
items.scene: Trevor Belmont from Castlevania, adult weathered vampire hunter, tousled dark brown hair and short stubble, unmistakable tired defiance in his eyes. Worn ivory-white high-collared belted coat with dark leather reinforcement, brown shoulder straps, muted red lining, black trousers and practical tall boots. In a low three-quarter advancing pivot after a whip strike, left foot forward and weight grounded, coat flaring. One hand visibly grips the handle of his long chain whip; the chain follows ONE clean natural sweeping curve from the hand through open space toward the frame edge, no disconnected floating links, other hand relaxed near his belt for balance. His jaw clenches, a small grim almost-amused expression amid exhaustion. A damp narrow stone bridge with one broken parapet against broad blue-grey dusk; no distant city. Warm torch reflection catches ivory fabric, brass fittings and his cheek; sparse rain. The action feels resourceful and stubborn, not a superhero landing.
